label: UI yields — two spells on the stack
prompt: ui-gate `game-manage-yields` surface (scripts/ui-gate/surfaces.ts, issue #3629). Two objects so the walk can yield the BOTTOM one without auto-passing. `activePlayer`/`priority` both on "me" since issue #3652 (ADR 0132 §4): without them the position inherited the dealt game's turn holder, so which seat the viewer followed was decided by the coin toss. Seed with: bunx convex run debugScenarios:seedScenarioDirect "$(cat scripts/ui-gate/yields-scenario.json)". Deployment-local by design (ADR 0044) — the lane seeds it at bootstrap.
